newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures rise to mixed on more US data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures rise to mixed on more US data.

text.p: May 15 - U.S. debt futures briefly rose to mixed levels, new morning highs, after more U.S. economic data. May Philly Fed business activity index fell to 1.6 from 5.7 in April. All components showed declines. April real earnings for U.S. workers fell 0.9 pct after upwardly revised 0.4-pct rise in March. June T-bonds probed above Weds' settle at 110-05/32.
